three.js r128 example addons (MIT), copied from `three@0.128.0/examples/jsm/` with the bare `'three'` import
rewritten to `../../three.module.js`. Used by the Tech Net (`src/menu/technet.js`): orbit controls + bloom.

Also `loaders/GLTFLoader.js` — loads the capital-ship GLBs (`content/ships/`, `src/render3d/ships/`).
Also `objects/Lensflare.js` — lens flare for the ship presentation (`src/render3d/space/`).
